title: Nova Scotia Wine Tour Sparkling Wines and Local Bites
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour is a must for wine and food lovers. Begin your day with coffee and treats from a popular Halifax cafe before heading to the picturesque Annapolis Valley. Along the way, enjoy a conversation with a local about Nova Scotia's rich history, culture and, of course, its exceptional wines. Visit three unique wineries, where you'll savour sparkling wine tastings paired with thoughtfully selected local snacks, ranging from charcuterie, cheese or oysters, ensuring a delightful culinary experience.

- Enjoy a scenic drive from Halifax to Annapolis Valley
- Have a knowledgeable local guide you along your visit
- Taste sparkling wines at three local wineries
- Indulge in expertly paired local bites
- Pickup available from your hotel or cruise ship port
